summary: Comprehensive E2E testing of the NEW Unified Filter Bar and Combined PDF Export feature. All features working correctly: Unified filter bar visible at top of Analytics page shared across all 4 tabs (Overview, Pipeline Funnel, Revenue, Performance). Filter dropdowns (Employer, Team, Recruiter) populate correctly. Date presets (7d, 30d, 90d, YTD) dynamically update date inputs. Clear button resets all filters. Export Report button downloads a valid 9KB combined PDF with all 4 sections.

Filter persistence across tabs works correctly via React state in parent component
